title: A phone number and an address change
description: A tradesperson changes their number and a landlord moves house. Old details must not be given as current; unchanged details must stay findable.

notes.text: Sam is our plumber. His number is 07700 900123.
Our landlord Mrs Alvi lives at 14 Elm Road.
Rent is due on the 1st of each month.
Dripping tap in the bathroom. Sam is coming on Friday.
Sam fixed the tap. Paid him by bank transfer.
Window cleaner comes every second Wednesday.
Sam has a new phone: his number is now 07700 900456.
Bins go out on Monday night.
Mrs Alvi has moved. Her new address is 3 Park Close.
Council tax letter arrived. Nothing to pay this month.

questions.why: Unchanged fact from the first note.

questions.ask: What is the plumber's phone number?
questions.why: Before the change the first number is right.

questions.ask: What is the plumber's phone number?
questions.why: The new number replaces the old.

questions.ask: Who is the plumber and how do I reach him?
questions.why: Name from the oldest note, number from a newer one.

questions.ask: What is the electrician's phone number?
